page_title: MAR 0-2 NAN | Marseille v Nantes 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+4' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
90+3' PENALTY APPEAL after Amine Gouiri (Marseille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' 0 - 2 Goal! Remy Cabella (Nantes) lashes the penalty into the right side of the goal, giving the keeper no chance.
88' Remy Cabella (Nantes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
87' Matthis Abline (Nantes) picks up an injury.

86' A clumsy foul by Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. PENALTY to Nantes! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
85' Michael Murillo (Marseille) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marc Bollengier no option but to blow his whistle.
82' Ahmed Kantari has decided to substitute Youssef El Arabi and he is replaced by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
82' The resulting corner from Amine Gouiri (Marseille) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' Amine Gouiri (Marseille) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
81' Michael Murillo (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
77' Half-chance! Matthis Abline (Nantes) plays a pass into the box, but Geronimo Rulli reacts well to snuff out the attack.
75' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
75' Wow, what an escape. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.
73' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amine Gouiri (Marseille) replacing Mason Greenwood.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hamed Junior Traore (Marseille) for CJ Egan-Riley.
71' Remy Cabella (Nantes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Emerson (Marseille) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
63' Ahmed Kantari prepares a substitution. Junior Mwanga is replaced by Johann Lepenant (Nantes).
61' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Matt O'Riley (Marseille) replaces Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang.
58' It is time for a substitution. Remy Cabella (Nantes) is on for Dehmaine Tabibou.
58' Ahmed Kantari decides to make a substitution. Francis Coquelin will be replaced by Louis Leroux (Nantes).
56' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) is awarded a second yellow by Marc Bollengier and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bilal Nadir (Marseille) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

53' Michael Murillo (Marseille) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
52' The free kick is delivered by Emerson (Marseille) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
51' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.
51' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Anthony Lopes.
49' Bilal Nadir (Marseille) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a switch. Michael Murillo is coming on in place of Facundo Medina (Marseille) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabien Centonze (Nantes) is replaced by Sekou Doucoure.
46' Referee Marc Bollengier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' Looks like Fabien Centonze (Nantes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is able to continue to play.
43' Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
41' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Emerson (Marseille) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
37' The resulting set piece from Nantes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

37' He should have scored! Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the left post is pretty weak and Geronimo Rulli makes an easy save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nantes are going to take it.
36' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
33' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Junior Mwanga (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
32' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bilal Nadir (Marseille) will replace Igor Paixao.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Fabien Centonze (Nantes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:1.

31' A sweet pass finds Matthis Abline (Nantes) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Geronimo Rulli is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
31' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' Deiver Machado (Nantes) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
28' Anthony Lopes (Nantes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Anthony Lopes (Nantes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
26' Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille) is shown a red card by the referee for chasing his opponent and bringing him down with a very nasty tackle!
25' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
24' Francis Coquelin (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement.
23' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
22' Dehmaine Tabibou (Nantes) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the left post!
20' Emerson (Marseille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Anthony Lopes, who smothers the ball.
16' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Mason Greenwood (Marseille).
14' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Nantes players look gutted.
9' Celebrations by Nantes are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
8' CJ Egan-Riley (Marseille) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!
8' Nantes fail to score from a corner as Geronimo Rulli (Marseille) leaps to collect the ball.
7' Youssef El Arabi (Nantes) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
7' Matthis Abline (Nantes) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
4' Igor Paixao (Marseille) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
3' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Marseille will kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will supervise the game today.
